bullets.text: In Ponneri, contract workers staged a protest with their families at the Kattupalli desalination plant demanding compensation after an accident broke a worker's leg.
Residents in Gummidipoondi and Thiruvallur protested on roads over severe four-hour power cuts, raising complaints against electricity board officials.
Two people died in an accident on the Maduravoyal bypass road near Vanagaram after a motorist lost control and crashed into a truck.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay jointly travelled on the newly inaugurated Poonamallee to Vadapalani corridor of the Chennai Metro.
The Greater Chennai Traffic Police announced traffic diversions for commercial and heavy motor vehicles across Chennai during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit.
Pallikaranai police arrested a young couple for stealing cash and jewellery from a doctor's house just months after joining work.
Residents in Adyar's Gandhi Nagar stepped out during the weekend to walk through streets and assess their neighborhood's green cover and damage.
Boopalan, a 38-year-old farmer from Thalavedu village near Tiruttani, died by suicide after suffering from stomach ailments for months.
Gummidipoondi BDO office launched 24 new vehicles funded by CSR initiatives to collect garbage across 21 village panchayats.
Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Maharashtra, and Haryana rank among states with the highest share of workers in occupations where AI can improve productivity.
Suzlon announced a Rs 550 crore investment to set up three AI-powered blade factories across Gujarat, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu by 2027.
Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran released a private white paper discussing AI, automation, workforce exposure, and policy directions.
May 17 Movement members were arrested in Chennai for holding a black flag protest against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit, alongside house arrests of Congress members.
Contractors halted work in Chennai after ruling party affiliates allegedly demanded a Rs 50 lakh bribe for quarrying gravel soil.
Student federation members staged a protest in Besant Nagar wearing blindfolds and displaying banners regarding the SIR issue and national leaders.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Rs 4,900 crore 15-km Chennai Metro Phase II stretch alongside Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay urged the Centre to grant early approval for Chennai Metro Phase III and release education funds.
